data.description: ART_1, ART_7, and ART_13 claim the log requires safe (not idempotent) writers because append is non-idempotent but tolerates duplicates via dedup keys. ART_4, ART_9, and ART_18 claim the log requires idempotent writers because deterministic replay demands the replayed log be identical to the original, and safety permits state divergence. The disagreement turns on whether 'safe' tolerable duplicates suffice for deterministic replay or whether only true idempotency (identical log state regardless of retry count) satisfies it.
